notes.title: User Interface updates
notes.content:
[h1]ZEN BLOCKS - UPDATE[/h1]

We have updated and increased the frame rate settings, plus some other changes listed below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30904313/f98334cce51837688bf20595fc766e152a3c3f8a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Added 64-bit Build for Windows
[*] Small UI Bug fixes
[*] Along with FULL SCREEN mode, Multiple 16:9 Window Modes: (F3) 1024x576, (F4) 1152x648, (F5) 1280x720
[*] Pressing "N" toggles "night mode"

[/list]
